releaseNotes.learnMore: Read about our funding and this setting (Japanese)
releaseNotes.title: Release notes and supporting Floorp
releaseNotes.description: Advertising revenue supports Floorp development and operation. Choose how to open release notes after updates. You can change this later in Settings → Updates & Experiments.

disabled.label: Do not open automatically
disabled.description: Do not open release notes after updates. Keep your blocker settings when visiting the blog.

blocking.label: Open with your blocker settings
blocking.description: Keep your extensions working as configured. This does not install or enable an ad blocker.

support.label: Allow ads to support Floorp (recommended)
support.description: Restrict uBlock Origin, AdGuard, Adblock Plus, AdBlock and Ghostery on the Floorp blog.

releaseNotes.scope: The restriction applies to all HTTPS pages on blog.floorp.app, including manually opened pages, and affects tracking protection and custom filters as well as ad blocking. Other extensions are not restricted by this setting. Ads may still be blocked by other protection tools. Reload open blog pages after changing the setting.
releaseNotes.applyOnConfirm: Your selection takes effect only when you confirm. Closing this page keeps your current setting.
releaseNotes.applyOnFinish: This is a draft selection. It takes effect when you finish setup on the next screen. Closing setup before then keeps your current setting.
releaseNotes.error: Could not load or save your selection. Please reopen this page and try again.

hubPage.title: About Floorp Hub
hubPage.subtitle: A central place for Floorp-specific settings.
hubPage.description: Floorp Hub is a dedicated settings center for Floorp-specific options. You can open it by navigating to 'about:hub'. It can also be accessed from the left sidebar of Firefox's settings page at 'about:preferences'.
hubPage.tip: Tip: You can also access Floorp Hub from the Firefox settings sidebar.

features.accessible: Accessible from about:hub or Firefox settings
features.centralized: All Floorp-specific options in one place

customize.title: Customize Floorp
customize.description: Customize to your preferred settings. You can always change them later from the Floorp Hub or settings page.

appearance.title: Appearance Settings
appearance.description: You can customize Floorp's appearance to your preference. Choose a light or dark theme, or have it automatically switch based on your system settings.

floorpHub.title: Floorp Hub
floorpHub.description: Floorp Hub is a dedicated settings center for Floorp-specific options. You can open it by navigating to 'about:hub'. It can also be accessed from the left sidebar of Firefox's settings page at 'about:preferences'.

finish.title: Setup Complete!
finish.subtitle: Congratulations! You've completed the Floorp setup. Enjoy a comfortable and secure internet browsing experience.
finish.hint: For more detailed settings, you can customize via the Settings option in the menu button at the top right.

welcomePage.description: Floorp is a fast and user-friendly web browser that emphasizes privacy and security. This guide will introduce you to the main features and settings of Floorp.

localizationPage.title: Floorp speaks your language
localizationPage.subtitle: Check language settings and change if needed
localizationPage.chooseLanguage: Choose from a wide range of languages
localizationPage.languageChangeNotice: Changing language will apply the new language without restarting Floorp. Some add-ons may not support language changes.

featuresPage.title: Main Floorp Features
featuresPage.subtitle: Floorp comes with many useful features. Check out the feature overview!

panelSidebar.title: Panel Sidebar
panelSidebar.description: Access convenient features from the sidebar on the right while browsing. You can place web panels, note-taking functions, add-ons, bookmarks, etc. in the sidebar.
features: Quickly take notes with Floorp Notes while browsing

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Organize multiple tab sets to streamline your work. Quickly switch between workspaces with distinctive icons and names. Access via the workspace button in the top left.
features: Categorize by purpose: work, personal, etc.

pwa.title: Progressive Web Applications Support
pwa.description: On Windows, you can add PWA-compatible sites as desktop applications when you visit them. Regular websites can also be installed.
features: Can be pinned to the taskbar

mouseGesture.title: Mouse Gestures
mouseGesture.description: Control your browser more intuitively with natively implemented mouse gesture functionality. Execute gestures by holding the right-click button and moving your mouse.
